turns.instruction:
Build and analyze the attached frame in PKPM. Story 1 pressure is 10 kN/m2 and story 2 pressure is 8 kN/m2. Only the two first-story corner columns on y=0, at x=0 and x=12 m, use E=210000 MPa; every other member uses E=200000 MPa. Report the specified responses.
Use the stated PKPM engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Replace only the story 2 floor pressure by 9 kN/m2 downward and rerun PKPM. Recompute its X-beam line loads without accumulating the old loads. Keep story 1 at 10 kN/m2, preserve both special first-story column materials, all sections, supports and topology, and report current responses.
